title: Tuning temperature, top-k and top-p to the task

videos.script: Before a model writes a word, it gives every word it could write a score. A separate step, the sampler, picks one. {{title}} Here are eight candidates after the words your parcel is. On scores highest. Delayed is close behind. Purple is near the bottom. {{scores}} Divide the scores by a low temperature and almost every draw is the top word. Raise it, and the tail wakes up. Purple gets drawn. {{temperature}} Top-k and top-p cut that tail off before the draw. One keeps a fixed number of words. The other keeps a share of the probability. {{cut}} Then the triage prompt, five calls per message. At temperature zero, all five agree. At temperature one, right answers turn wrong, and one request for an exchange comes back three different ways. {{task}} By the end of this lesson you can read a sampling setting as arithmetic. You can choose one for the task in front of you. And you can say why zero is still not a promise on a hosted model. {{close}}
